summary: Found one blocking data-integrity defect. Scope, README ownership, and existing test preservation look appropriate. Fourteen prebuilt recorder tests passed; the filesystem-writing test was excluded to honor the read-only review.

findings.finding: Canonicalization silently changes valid policy statistics. serde_json is configured without `float_roundtrip`, so reparsing the serialized JSON can round an f64 differently: a policy value of 0.9999999999999999 becomes 1.0 through the default parser's significand conversion and division. The writer then seals the changed value, and loading succeeds with data different from the original episode. This violates the advertised exact-field persistence contract. Enable roundtrip-safe float parsing for both canonicalization and loading, and add regression tests preserving nontrivial finite value estimates and log probabilities exactly.
